name: Zone Collapse
description: The shrinking safe area that gives a battle royale its clock. Owns the zone geometry per phase (center and radius), the shrink schedule, and the escalating damage tick outside it. Being outside the zone IS a hazard, and the tick is delivered through world.hazard_volume rather than a private damage path so 'on fire from the zone' and 'on fire from lava' share one pipeline — but the damage ladder lives here, because zone damage must escalate on the match clock, not on hazard tuning. The next circle is revealed a phase ahead (world.zoneRevealed) because the rotation decision is the strategy layer; killing stragglers is only enforcement. When phases advance and when the match ends is progression.match_lifecycle's call — this component enforces geography, never victory.

inputs.name: phaseRadii
inputs.description: Safe-zone radius per phase, largest first. Declared as data rather than computed from a shrink factor so designers can hand-place the tense endgame circles instead of accepting whatever the math produces.

inputs.name: damagePerTickByPhase
inputs.description: Damage per tick while outside the zone, indexed by phase. Escalation is the point: early zone is a nudge, late zone is a wall. Must be tuned against combat.damage_resolver's health pools, not in isolation.

inputs.name: tickIntervalSeconds
inputs.description: How often outside-zone damage is applied. Ticks rather than continuous drain so the damage is legible and so world.hazard_volume's enter/exit semantics still mean something.

inputs.name: shrinkDurationSeconds
inputs.description: How long the boundary takes to travel from current radius to the next phase's radius. The travel window — not the damage — is what creates the rotation fights the genre is about.

inputs.name: revealAheadPhases
inputs.description: How many phases ahead the next circle is shown on the map. 0 turns the mode into pure reaction; 2+ removes the gamble. One phase is the genre's settled answer.

outputs.name: currentPhase
outputs.description: Index into phaseRadii. progression.match_lifecycle reads this to know when the endgame has begun.

outputs.name: currentRadius
outputs.description: Live safe-zone radius, interpolating during a shrink. The minimap renders this; nothing else should compute its own copy.

outputs.name: isShrinking
outputs.description: True while the boundary is moving. AI and audio both key off this — the shrink is the match's loudest sentence.
